headline: Developing Nations' External Debt Hits Record $9.4 Trillion
summary: World Bank data indicates that external debt in developing countries reached a record $9.4 trillion last year. Poorest nations are currently facing their highest interest servicing costs since the late 1980s, hindering domestic investment.
why: High levels of external debt in developing nations can lead to fiscal instability, currency crises, and reduced capacity for infrastructure or social spending, which are critical factors for international investors and global economic development.
